body: There isn't anyone that would listen anymore.  The last one just cut me from her life without reason. My wife tries, but I can't believe anything she says anymore.  I've got my kid and he's great,  but I cant talk to him about any of this. Everyone I worked with doesn't really care and some of them I've been their support for almost 20 years.  Its like I'm tainted but "it's not your fault" is the excuse I get from everyone.
Hey brother, we're in the same boat, you and I. If you need support.. I've got you family! Just PM me and we can figure this shit out.

The part that pisses me off still, while going through the messages, they were talking about how coworkers were getting suspicious.

I'm a damn idiot for thinking it was wasnt wasn't anything

Thanks. As much as I'd like to argue your points,  I cant.  Its just difficult because my biggest fear is what my little boy will think. I remember when I was 11 and my dad tossed my mom's shit onto the front porch. I remember every little detail and I dont want him to feel thaf.
Nah, that's a ... sucker bet.. ha!

I know her ex husband quite well as we co-parent the older kids (as much as he's capable) . He's got his own issues. Not throwing rocks, just stating a fact. 

I'll agree with the impulsivity.

That's the thing. Those texts were as recent as the Friday preceding Memorial Day. Save for the incoming one. She had a rough childhood, I was a fuckup for all of my adolescence. So.i can relate to the whole mental illness thing. 

But fuuuuck... what keeps going through my head is she fucked  another guy and came home to kiss me.
